items.title: The sequence of blowups along a nonsingular arc reaches a regular point when one local ring is regular
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file resolve.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a two dimensional Noetherian local domain with a surjection onto a complete discrete valuation ring defining a nonsingular arc, if the local ring at the kernel prime is regular then one of the blowups in the sequence determined by the arc is regular at the point of the arc (statement lines 2896-2909). The proof (proof lines 2911-2954) works with a minimal generating set of the kernel, derives relations controlled by powers of a uniformizer, and shows that passing to the affine blowup algebra strictly decreases the relevant exponents, forcing termination. H3: an original termination argument with explicit blowup computations, written out in full.
